\section*{Complex layout citation fixture}

\begin{multicols}{2}
\subsection*{Left column}
Deterministic identity prevents citation drift after reprocessing [1].
The paragraph wraps across several visual lines so reading-order recovery cannot rely on one physical line per paragraph.

\fbox{\parbox{0.40\textwidth}{
\textbf{Evidence note.} This boxed callout separates visual grouping from semantic reading order.
}}

\columnbreak
\subsection*{Right column}
Table-aware extraction preserves bibliography entries that ordinary paragraph recovery can miss [2].
A third source covers stable links across mixed page layouts [3].
The numeric interval [0,1] remains non-citation content.
\end{multicols}
